title: Planning-oriented Autonomous Driving
grouping: Left column holds (a) standalone models and (b) a multi-task framework; a thin vertical grey rule separates it from (c), which stacks three rows (c.1 vanilla, c.2 explicit design, c.3 the proposed design). An italic grey axis 'perception - prediction - planning' runs under (c) as a phase scale.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded rectangles: grey filled task boxes, white outlined modules and heads, small node-link networks for the standalone models, a grey 3-D feature-stack glyph for each backbone. Each row in (c) starts with the same backbone glyph and ends with a red 'Planner' box (dashed outline in c.2). In c.3 the module boxes take the overview's colours (blue tracking, purple mapping, green motion, yellow occupancy, red planner). Sans-serif labels.
proposed_highlight: The proposed row is the only coloured one, its sub-caption is bold and ends with '(Ours)', and its module colours match the main overview figure.
lesson: Compare driving paradigms as stacked rows that share the same backbone glyph at the left and the same red Planner box at the right, so only the middle changes; colour only the proposed row, in the overview's module colours.
notes: Venue CVPR 2023 from the arXiv comment (venue_source: arxiv-journal-ref). The whole figure is a single raster image in the PDF (refs crop recorded one embedded image covering the crop), so kb measure cannot separate photos from drawing: photo_share is null and the palette includes the embedded photos and renders.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
